lin.name: Pocket Timeline

changes: carry the companion into one more page-wide role it does not have yet (heading, label, card-edge, secondary, bubble-them, bar or ambient: pick the one that suits it)
rearrange Home: a different column structure or order (for example the monitor full width above the lists, or the lists side by side)
light text on the dark ground eased half a weight or grade, so it does not bloom

lin.idea: Home ordered as time on one spine: NOW (the question), then NEXT (the tube), then Coming up, then LATER, with the lists beside it; every page strung along a timeline
